key_insight: Giving a language model read-only SQL access to structured perovskite device data raises quantitative question-answering accuracy to about 51%, versus 16–23% with standard passage retrieval.
engineering_relevance: Reliable literature-scale comparisons of perovskite solar cells require structured measurement tables, not just retrieval of paper excerpts.
method: Compute 755 ground-truth answers directly from 45,441 measured device records.
Benchmark six retrieval architectures over 158,274 passages from 25,662 papers.
Test an open 14B model with read-only SQL access on a single 24 GB GPU.
evidence_signal: SQL-enabled accuracy reached 51.5% on historical literature and 50.8% on prospective literature, while zero-shot accuracy ranged from 1.6% to 6.5%.
watch_item: Accuracy remains near 51%, and deployment depends on extracting and maintaining trustworthy structured device records.
paper_title: Benchmark for Structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Perovskite Photovoltaics
